question.text: Which of the following investments provides returns that are linked to the performance of the underlying business?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the NISM Series XVII Retirement Adviser workbook (pages 24-25), stocks/shares have returns that are linked to business performance, and pages 34-35 add that equity provides ownership, dividends, and appreciation but with volatility and no guaranteed returns. The Trap: PPF and NSC carry government-declared rates and bank FDs are set by the bank - none of these are linked to underlying business performance, so only equity in this list qualifies. Note: Highlight to clients that the trade-off for business-linked upside is the absence of guaranteed returns - equity returns depend on company performance and market conditions.
